name: Avatares AI - Admin - Init Ingest Profiles

parameters.query:
CREATE EXTENSION IF NOT EXISTS pgcrypto;

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS ingest_profiles (
  profile_id UUID PRIMARY KEY DEFAULT gen_random_uuid(),
  profile_name TEXT NOT NULL,

  avatar TEXT NOT NULL,
  avatar_short TEXT NOT NULL,
  scene TEXT NOT NULL,
  asset_type TEXT NOT NULL,

  workflow TEXT NOT NULL,
  model TEXT NOT NULL,
  seed BIGINT NULL,
  version INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 1,
  auto_promote_latest BOOLEAN NOT NULL DEFAULT false,

  is_active BOOLEAN NOT NULL DEFAULT false,
  is_enabled BOOLEAN NOT NULL DEFAULT true,

  created_at TIMESTAMPTZ NOT NULL DEFAULT now(),
  updated_at TIMESTAMPTZ NOT NULL DEFAULT now(),

  UNIQUE (avatar, scene, asset_type, workflow, model, version)
);

CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_ingest_profiles_active
  ON ingest_profiles (is_active, is_enabled);

CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_ingest_profiles_avatar_scene
  ON ingest_profiles (avatar, scene, asset_type);

CREATE UNIQUE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS uq_ingest_profiles_single_active
  ON ingest_profiles ((is_active))
  WHERE is_active = true;

UPDATE ingest_profiles
SET is_active = false
WHERE is_active = true;

INSERT INTO ingest_profiles (
  profile_name,
  avatar,
  avatar_short,
  scene,
  asset_type,
  workflow,
  model,
  seed,
  version,
  auto_promote_latest,
  is_active,
  is_enabled
)
VALUES (
  'Estefanía / Coffee Rain / Raw Image',
  'estefania-montealegre',
  'estefania',
  'coffee-rain',
  'raw-image',
  'flux-krea-dev',
  'flux-krea-dev',
  847362,
  1,
  false,
  true,
  true
)
ON CONFLICT (avatar, scene, asset_type, workflow, model, version)
DO UPDATE SET
  profile_name = EXCLUDED.profile_name,
  avatar_short = EXCLUDED.avatar_short,
  seed = EXCLUDED.seed,
  auto_promote_latest = EXCLUDED.auto_promote_latest,
  is_active = true,
  is_enabled = true,
  updated_at = now();

SELECT 'ok' AS status;
